Beware if you have a nut allergy, they will serve you sauces with nuts anyway. They don't seem to get it.
Feb 2025 • Friends
We recently ate here and there was one person in our group who had a life threatening nut allergy. After explaining this to the waitress she assured her there were no nuts in the butter chicken. When it arrived our friend was suspect so she just touched her tongue to the sauce and got an immediate reaction. Had she taken a mouthful, it could have been catastrophic. As it turns out, there were cashew nut in the butter chicken. This restaurant does not appreciate dietary concerns, even if they're life threatening. It was only after we left the restaurant did we realize they charged us for her uneaten meal. I would not recommend this restaurant.
Written February 28, 2025
